title: Fee Basis Scale for Late Surgical Moves — Riverbend Self-Pay Outpatient Surgery Package
content:
Scale applying to the late-change fee on a moved Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Outpatient Surgery booking under Good Faith & Price Estimates: the fee basis rises with the moved booking's package price.

**Scale.** The moved booking's package price is the sum of the Riverbend facility line and the Riverbend professional line carrying the principal service code on the current version. A moved booking's package price of $5000.00 or more sets the fee basis at the type's late-cancellation fee plus one percent (1 percent) of that price; one of $2500.00 or more and below $5000.00 sets it at the larger of the type's late-cancellation fee and five percent (5 percent) of that price; one below $2500.00 leaves the fee basis at the type's late-cancellation fee, unchanged by the price. The fee basis itself is not rounded.

| Moved booking's package price | Fee basis |
|---|---|
| $5000.00 or more | the late-cancellation fee plus 1 percent of the price |
| $2500.00 or more, below $5000.00 | the larger of the late-cancellation fee and 5 percent of the price |
| below $2500.00 | the late-cancellation fee, unchanged |

## Worked figures (hypothetical prices; late-cancellation fee read from the deposit schedule, taken here as 150.00)

| Package price | Computation | Fee basis |
|---|---|---|
| 6123.40 | 150.00 plus 61.234 | 211.234 |
| 5000.00 | 150.00 plus 50.00 | 200.00 |
| 4999.99 | larger of 150.00 and 249.9995 | 249.9995 |
| 2600.00 | larger of 150.00 and 130.00 | 150.00 |
| 2499.99 | below the scale | 150.00 |

Co-provider lines and lines of other service codes are not part of the moved booking's package price.
